name: CBFA2/RUNX1 partner transcriptional co-repressor 3

function.text: CBFA2T3 encodes transcriptional corepressor CBFA2T3. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: CBFA2T3 encodes transcriptional corepressor CBFA2T3. Based in part on similarity, it can repress the expression of MMP7 in a ZBTB33-dependent manner. It contributes to inhibition of glycolysis and stimulation of mitochondrial respiration by down-regulating the expression of glycolytic genes including PFKFB3, PFKFB4, PDK1, PFKP, LDHA and HK1 which are direct targets of HIF1A. It regulates the proliferation and the differentiation of erythroid progenitors by repressing the expression of TAL1 target genes.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CBFA2T3 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.
